# Pesher Habakkuk Column 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 5 | **Condition:** Well preserved

---

**5:1** "[...] 'Are-You-not from-of-old,

**5:2** O LORD my-God, my-Holy-One? You-shall-not-die.

**5:3** O LORD, You-have-appointed him for-judgment;

**5:4** and-O Rock, You-have-established him for-rebuke' (Hab 1:12)."

**5:5** Its pesher: God will-not destroy His-people by-the-hand-of the-nations;

**5:6** but by-the-hand-of His-chosen-ones

**5:7** God will-judge all the-nations, and-by-their-rebuke

**5:8** all the-wicked-ones-of His-people will-be-found-guilty.

**5:9** "[You] whose-eyes are-too-pure to-look upon evil,

**5:10** and-who-cannot gaze upon wrongdoing:

**5:11** why do-you-look upon traitors

**5:12** and-remain-silent when-the-wicked swallows one-more-righteous than-he?" (Hab 1:13)

**5:13** Its pesher concerns the-House-of-Absalom

**5:14** and-the-members-of their-council, who-were-silent

**5:15** at-the-rebuke-of the-Teacher-of-Righteousness and-did-not help-him

**5:16** against the-Man-of-the-Lie, who-rejected

**5:17** the-Torah in-the-midst-of their-whole council.

---
*EMET notes: Column 5 covers Hab 1:12-13. The pesher format alternates between quotations of Habakkuk and their sectarian interpretations (pesharim). Hyphenated forms reflect Hebrew construct chains and bound morphemes. Technical sectarian terms preserved: Teacher of Righteousness (Moreh ha-Tsedeq), Wicked Priest (ha-Kohen ha-Rasha'), Man of the Lie (Ish ha-Kazav), Kittim (identified with Romans), Spouter of the Lie (Mattif ha-Kazav). Lacunae marked with [...] represent genuine manuscript damage.*
